summary:
Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the thin ignite handler adapters, plus the dtype default change, renamed callers, and the five test files. Nothing is committed and nothing was run: tests, flake8, and scripts were not executed, and the checks were done by reading only (line length, whitespace, final newlines, unused imports).

Changed or new files:
- monai/data/csv_saver.py (new): CSVSaver with save, save_batch, and finalize. Overwrite-false merge keeps in-memory positions and appends file-only keys in file order.
- monai/data/nifti_saver.py (new): NiftiSaver with a private static _create_file_basename. Dtype is the saver's dtype if set, otherwise the data's own dtype.
- monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py: added plot_2d_or_3d_image. Existing GIF helpers unchanged.
- monai/handlers/segmentation_saver.py: holds a NiftiSaver, one save_batch call per iteration, one info log.
- monai/handlers/classification_saver.py: holds a CSVSaver, registers an engine-accepting wrapper on Events.COMPLETED.
- monai/handlers/tensorboard_handlers.py: TensorBoardImageHandler takes index before max_channels and delegates to the plot function.
- monai/data/nifti_writer.py: default dtype changed from "float32" to np.float32.
- examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_array.py, examples/segmentation_3d/unet_evaluation_dict.py, tests/integration_sliding_window.py: output_path renamed to output_dir.
- tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py (new); tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py updated to pass filename.

Choices: the plot tests use a SummaryWriter subclass that records add_image calls to assert exact tags. The GIF path has no add_image call, so the 4D case only checks the run directory exists. Tensor affines are converted to numpy in NiftiSaver. CSVSaver asserts the filename ends in .csv. tests/test_handler_tb_image.py was left unchanged; it still works with index defaulting to 0. Docs pages were not added.

Note: monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py changed on disk mid-session. I re-read it, confirmed my appended function and the existing helpers are present, and did not investigate further.
